break_even.comparison: candidate cheaper above crossover; baseline cheaper below
break_even.scope: A common fraction of normal input price applies to every LLM model. A single USD-per-million crossover is reported only when ordinary input rates agree. No local compute, idle capacity or TCO is priced by this crossover.

Unknown cost or local duration excludes the pair. Cached input is priced at the full input rate; this is not observed invoice savings.
